name: color-contrast
title: Color Contrast
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: WCAG 2 contrast helpers over OKLCH: contrast ratio and level, the ranges of any OKLCH, HSL, HSB or RGB channel where a color passes against a background (passingRanges), the passing part of a 2D color area such as chroma × lightness (passingRegion), and the nearest passing color that keeps its hue (nearestContrastColor). Results are oklch strings clamped to sRGB.
